meta.description: Ultra-wide SEO checklist covering on-page, technical, UX, schema, international, Core Web Vitals, E-E-A-T and VIN-specific features.

checks.text: Meta <title> is present.
Meta <title> length 50–60 characters.
Primary keyword appears in <title> near the beginning.
Brand name appended in title (e.g., "| VIN Trust").
Meta description is present.
Meta description length 140–160 characters.
Primary query intent reflected in meta description.
Meta description contains soft CTA (e.g., "Check VIN now").
<meta name="viewport"> correctly configured for mobile.
<meta charset="utf-8"> is present.
No meta robots=noindex/nofollow on indexable pages.
Correct canonical points to single canonical URL.
og:title, og:description, og:type, og:url are set.
og:image exists, has correct size and aspect ratio.
Twitter Card meta (summary_large_image) configured.
<html lang="en"> / "es" matches actual page language.
Favicon linked in <head>.
theme-color set and matches main brand color.
WebPage schema present with name, description, inLanguage, url.
Organization/Brand schema for VIN Trust (name, url, logo, contact).
SearchAction for VIN form: target with VIN parameter.
JSON-LD is valid (checked via Google Rich Results Test).
Below-fold images load lazily (loading="lazy").
No 4000px+ images inserted in small blocks without resize.
JS bundle optimized (no unnecessary megabytes).
Target pages have hero section with VIN form (input + CTA).
Clear value proposition: cheap and detailed VIN report.
CTA in top section of page.
No hidden subscriptions, deceptive buttons, price confusion.
